failureMessage: Learning Suggestions Foundation (developer.task.learning-suggestions-foundation) native local agent iteration sınırına ulaştı.

diagnosis.summary: local_agent_iteration_limit without a candidate came from the local agent burning the post-inspection budget on rejected read/search instead of mutating; the workspace still has only a partial Learning Suggestions scaffold that leaves auto-enqueue/start live and omits the userApproved approval gate.

rootCauseHypotheses.hypothesis: Process failure: after local_agent_implementation_phase / local_agent_target_found for AgentEngine.swift, the native agent kept calling read_file/search_codebase (rejected as implementation_required through grace then budget) and never issued replace_text/write_file/apply_patch, so no trustworthy candidate was produced before local_agent_iteration_limit.
evidence: Mentor/developer-log-tail.txt shows implementation phase at step ~1–2, then repeated local_agent_implementation_required + local_agent_iteration_grace for read_file/search_codebase through step 14/14, ending in local_agent_iteration_limit with no mutation stage.
Task reason in learning-suggestions-foundation-v1.json already records a prior 14-iteration read/search burn with no mutation.
Runtime source hints are empty; failure is budget exhaustion, not a thrown provider/resolver error.

rootCauseHypotheses.hypothesis: Semantic/product gap still open: capability-gap completion still auto-enqueues learning and may start workers, while AgentLearningSuggestionStore is only stub-wired (load on init) without accept/defer/suppress or observe-on-gap-completion, so the approval-gate contract is unimplemented.
evidence: AgentEngine still calls learningQueueStore.enqueue(...) then startNextLearningJobIfNeeded() on two capability-gap completion paths (~2050–2072 and ~3782–3797).

learningSuggestionStore is constructed and load()ed into @Published learningSuggestions, but has no other call sites; acceptLearningSuggestion/deferLearningSuggestion/suppressLearningSuggestion symbols are absent.
AgentLearningJob has no userApproved; nextQueued filters only state == .queued; enqueue has no userApproved parameter (default false required by brief).
Scripts/learning-suggestion-policy-self-test.mjs is missing despite verification.command requiring it.

rootCauseHypotheses.hypothesis: Partial scaffold is not build-integrable as-is: AgentLearningSuggestionStore.swift is untracked in project.pbxproj, and observe mutates let occurrenceCount/updatedAt (only state is var), plus deferred≥2 re-propose and suppressed permanence are missing—so even a narrow store-only edit would not satisfy the foundation gate.
evidence: project.pbxproj references AgentLearningStore.swift and AgentLearningQueue.swift but not AgentLearningSuggestionStore.swift.
AgentLearningSuggestion.occurrenceCount and updatedAt are let; observe does += 1 and updatedAt = Date().

observe duplicates by capabilityID+kind+reason and increments count but never transitions deferred→proposed after ≥2 new occurrences; suppressed auto-return is not implemented (also not incorrectly auto-returning).
sourceGoal is a parameter to observe but must not become a persisted suggestion field (model currently omits raw-content fields—good—but complete gate still missing).

recommendedNextSteps: Prefer mutation over further broad inspection: ALLOW paths already contain the full Phase-1 surface; target AgentLearningSuggestionStore + AgentLearningQueue + two AgentEngine gap-completion sites first.

Finish AgentLearningSuggestionStore: make occurrenceCount/updatedAt mutable (or reconstruct via copy), keep compact metadata only, upsert by capability fingerprint without persisting sourceGoal/raw bodies, implement deferred reopen after ≥2 new occurrences, never auto-unsuppress.
Add optional userApproved to AgentLearningJob (nil→false), enqueue(..., userApproved: Bool = false), and gate nextQueued on state==queued && userApproved==true.

Replace both AgentEngine gap-completion learningQueueStore.enqueue + unconditional startNextLearningJobIfNeeded chains with learningSuggestionStore.observe → learningSuggestions; do not auto-start workers from gap completion.

Add acceptLearningSuggestion(id)/deferLearningSuggestion(id)/suppressLearningSuggestion(id): accept builds generalized CapabilityGapResolution from suggestion metadata, enqueues with userApproved=true and generic source label (not raw prompt), then may call startNextLearningJobIfNeeded; defer/suppress only update suggestion state.
On learning job readyForReview/completed, mark matching suggestion approved/completed; ensure failed jobs do not auto-retry via startNextLearningJobIfNeeded.

Add AgentLearningSuggestionStore.swift to project.pbxproj; create Scripts/learning-suggestion-policy-self-test.mjs asserting nextQueued requires approval, gap paths do not auto-enqueue, accept path enqueues+starts, suggestion model lacks raw-content fields; then build_check + git_diff.
testsRequired: node Scripts/learning-suggestion-policy-self-test.mjs must exit 0 with learning_suggestion_policy_self_test_ok, auto_learning_gate=manual, raw_content_persistence=forbidden
Assert nextQueued returns nil for queued jobs with userApproved nil/false and returns only userApproved==true
Assert AgentEngine gap-completion paths call learningSuggestionStore.observe (or equivalent) and do not call learningQueueStore.enqueue
Assert acceptLearningSuggestion path enqueues with userApproved=true and may invoke startNextLearningJobIfNeeded; defer/suppress do not
warnings: Do not mutate ConversationSidebarView or other DENY paths; UI is Phase 2.
Do not alter existing system/physical approval chains; only insert the learning-suggestion approval gate.
Do not persist raw user prompts or task bodies into suggestion memory; accept must use a generic provenance/source label.
Failure of a learning job must not automatically start the next unapproved job.
Incomplete untracked AgentLearningSuggestionStore.swift alone is not a valid candidate without queue gating, Engine rewiring, pbxproj, and policy self-test.
